We are given a set of requirements (RW-SW-27 to RW-SW-44) and we must write a Gherkin test suite that covers each requirement with at least one scenario.
 The test suite must be in Gherkin (BDD DSL) and then we must output a JSON list of test cases that correspond to the scenarios.

 Important: 
   - Every requirement must be covered by at least one scenario.
   - We must have a Scenario Outline with Examples tables for normal, edge, and invalid values for the requirements that have boundaries (like RW-SW-39, RW-SW-42, RW-SW-44).
   - We must not invent values; use the ones from the requirements.

 Let's break down the requirements:

 [RW-SW-27] (functional) The event log must include all alarm occurrences
   -> We need to test that when an alarm occurs, it is logged.

 [RW-SW-28] (functional) The event log must include all alarm inhibitions, cancellations, resets, acknowledgements
   -> We need to test that when an alarm is inhibited, cancelled, reset, or acknowledged, it is logged.

 [RW-SW-31] (functional) GUI must allow inhibiting alarms
   -> We need to test that the GUI has a way to inhibit an alarm.

 [RW-SW-32] (functional) GUI must allow acknowledging alarms
   -> We need to test that the GUI has a way to acknowledge an alarm.

 [RW-SW-33] (functional) GUI must allow cancelling alarms
   -> We need to test that the GUI has a way to cancel an alarm.

 [RW-SW-39] (functional) GUI must allow setting an alarm on inspiration tidal volume above threshold between the bounds of 80 to 3000 ml in increments of 10ml
   -> This requires a scenario that sets the threshold to a value in [80, 3000] in steps of 10, and also tests boundaries and invalid values.

 [RW-SW-42] (functional) GUI must have an alarm that fires if for 3 consecutive breaths PIP > user-specified threshold
   -> We need to test that when PIP exceeds the threshold for 3 consecutive breaths, the alarm fires.

 [RW-SW-44] (functional) GUI must have an alarm that fires if amount of leakage is > user-specified threshold between 5 to 150lpm
   -> This requires a scenario that sets the leakage threshold in [5, 150] and tests boundaries and invalid values.
